captions.top: About a third of the way down

steps.text: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a support.
Bend your knees a little, keeping your heels down and your chest up.
Stop about a third of the way down.

safety: Hold a support the whole time.
Your knees should not go past your toes.

mistakes.label: too_deep
mistakes.wrong: you bent your knees further than a mini squat
mistakes.right: Only bend your knees a little, about a third of the way down.

mistakes.label: heels_lift
mistakes.wrong: your heels came off the floor
mistakes.right: Keep your heels on the floor.
